newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN MONEY RATES END UP ON BORROWERS' DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN MONEY RATES END UP ON BORROWERS' DEMAND.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates ended up on Saturday on demand from borrowers ahead of Sunday's weekend, but would remain soft on Monday on excess funds, dealers said.
"From the start there was strong demand today and initial deals were quoted around 16 percent," one dealer said. "Later the rates gained further and ended around 18.25 percent."
He said the demand persisted because some banks needed money to build up their reserves on the last day of the week.
